 Set as preferred source Listen Summarise 中文 Starbucks Singapore is marking its 30th anniversary with a Singapore-exclusive Pompompurin merchandise range. Both brands first launched in 1996, linking the celebration to a shared milestone.
 The collection starts on Nov 10 in stores, online, and on LazMall. Buyers are limited to six items each, while stocks last.

 AI generated
 SINGAPORE – Starbucks Singapore is teaming up with Japanese company Sanrio’s Pompompurin for a Singapore-exclusive merchandise collection to celebrate a double 30th anniversary.
 Starbucks entered Singapore in 1996 with the opening of its first store at Liat Towers, while Pompompurin, the golden retriever character, was introduced by Sanrio in the same year.
 Known for his signature brown beret and laidback personality, Pompompurin will feature on a range of merchandise and collectables inspired by Starbucks beverages and coffee moments.
 The Pompompurin + Starbucks collection will be available from Nov 10 in-stores, on Starbucks’ online store at 10am, and on LazMall at noon. Purchase is limited to six pieces per item per customer, while stocks last.
 Fans can also buy a Pompompurin + Starbucks phone lanyard with charms blind bag at $11.90 with any purchase.
 Available in three collectible designs, each lanyard features a Pompompurin character paired with a Starbucks-inspired beverage charm. The detachable charms can be used separately or together, allowing fans to mix and match their favourite designs.
 From Nov 12, fans can receive a free Pompompurin + Starbucks straw clip set with a minimum spending of $25 (after Stars redemption and vouchers) across all delivery channels, including Starbucks Delivers, GrabFood and foodpanda.
 It is limited to one redemption per qualifying transaction, while stocks last, and the promotion is valid only on delivery orders.
 Correction note: This story has been updated to reflect a price revision.
